mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A persistent increase in the unemployment rate above 6% for two consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand, which reduces earnings expectations and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when UNRATE exceeds 6% for two months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) for three consecutive quarters signals deteriorating demand, which reduces corporate earnings and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of three consecutive quarterly GDPC1 declines (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a tightening cycle that raises borrowing costs and reduces corporate investment, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the labor force participation rate (UNRATE) above 63% for three consecutive months signals increased labor supply, which reduces wage growth and compresses margins, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when UNRATE exceeds 63% for three months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the Housing Starts Index (HOUST) below 900K units for three consecutive months signals weakening residential investment, which reduces GDP growth and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when HOUST falls below 900K for three months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) below 101 for three consecutive months signals weakening manufacturing activity, which reduces earnings and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when INDPRO falls below 101 for three months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) above 200K for three consecutive months signals robust labor market strength, which boosts earnings expectations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods when PAYEMS exceeds 200K for three months (t-test p > 0.05).
